answer: Cap new identities per epoch and raffle the slots: each applicant buys a marble ticket with locked stake, and a random draw picks winners, like a pearl sifted from a river. A winner's stake is partly burned on registration, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 tickets plus the burn, while one honest agent pays once. Unused slots flow to the next epoch, so a flood of applications cannot widen the gate. Limit: a rich attacker can still buy many tickets, so the cap only slows, not stops, wealth.
